name: Image Ticker Carousel | by Creavi
author: Creavi

sections.description:
Elementor Image Ticker Carousel is a flexible and lightweight Elementor widget for creating continuously scrolling image tickers.

Use it to display logos, sponsors, products, featured items, or other images in a seamless horizontal loop. Each item can include an optional title, subtitle, and link. The widget works directly inside Elementor’s drag-and-drop editor and includes controls for motion, spacing, dimensions, and styling.

View the live demo: https://wordpress.creavi.dk/image-ticker-carousel-elementor/

Have an idea or need help? Contact the Creavi support team. We review user feedback when planning future updates.

Key Features

  • Multiple Image Support
    Add multiple images with optional titles, subtitles, and links for each item.

  • Title and Subtitle Controls
    Customize item typography, color, alignment, and spacing.

  • Optional Item Badges
    Add small labels such as New, Featured, Sale, Sponsor, or Partner to individual ticker items.

  • Customizable Scroll Speed
    Control the scroll speed in milliseconds to suit your design.

  • Infinite Looping Option
    Enable or disable seamless continuous scrolling.

  • Background Color Customization
    Choose an item background color that matches your site.

  • Customizable Border Radius
    Adjust the item corner radius for different visual styles.

  • Adjustable Image Dimensions
    Set custom image width and height using flexible units.

  • Spacing Between Items
    Adjust the spacing between ticker items.

  • Inner Item Padding
    Control the top, right, bottom, and left padding for each item.

  • Scroll Direction Control
    Choose left-to-right or right-to-left movement.

  • Pause on Hover
    Pause the ticker when a visitor hovers over it.

  • Optional Hover Emphasis
    Add a subtle interactive effect to ticker items.

External Services

When a site administrator explicitly selects Subscribe & Continue, the plugin sends the entered subscription email, administrator display name, site URL, an anonymous site hash, WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version, Elementor version, and locale to Creavi’s subscriber service at https://osecu.creavi.dk.

This information is used to provide requested security and feature updates, educational content, occasional Creavi offers, and plugin compatibility improvements. No information is sent when the administrator selects Skip. Administrators can change the subscription email or unsubscribe at any time from the Creavi Ticker page.

Creavi Privacy Policy: https://wordpress.creavi.dk/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and add the Creavi Image Ticker Scroll widget.
  5. Add your images and configure the ticker settings.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes. Elementor Pro is not required.

Can I control the speed and direction?

Yes. Both speed and direction are configurable in the widget settings.

Can I add text to each image?

Yes. Every item supports an optional title and subtitle with independent styling controls.

Can I link images to external URLs?

Yes. Each item can have an optional link with support for nofollow and opening in a new tab.

Is the ticker responsive?

Yes. The ticker is responsive and mobile-friendly by default.

Will the images loop infinitely?

Yes, when the Enable Infinite Loop setting is enabled.

Can I pause the ticker on hover?

Yes. A dedicated setting controls this behavior.

Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No. This plugin provides an Elementor widget and requires Elementor to be active.

Can I use custom image sizes?

Yes. Image width and height can be configured in the widget settings.

  • Improved the WordPress.org review request design with Creavi branding.
  • Removed the legacy 1.2 release notification from admin screens.
  • Updated Creavi support links to use the contact page.

1.2.2

  • Added optional badges for individual ticker items with position, color, typography, padding, and radius controls.

  • Added an optional, consent-based email subscription flow for product and compatibility updates.
  • Added a dedicated Creavi Ticker admin page with setup guidance, examples, and community support.
  • Added release notices for users updating from earlier plugin versions.
  • Added subscription email management and unsubscribe controls.

1.2.0

  • Added optional title and subtitle fields for every ticker item.
  • Added independent typography, color, alignment, and spacing controls for item text.
  • Improved linked items so the full image and text card is clickable.

1.1.1

  • Added an optional item hover effect.

1.0

  • Initial release with image repeater, scroll speed, direction, spacing, image sizing, optional links, hover pause, looping, and design controls.
